subject: Portfolio stipend: eligibility checklist & onboarding ops
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodai.com>
To: Samira Noor <samira@olivelabs.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodai.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2027-09-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Portfolio stipend: eligibility checklist & onboarding ops

Samira —

Thanks again for the demo earlier. Per our conversation, Redwood can offer Olive Labs a $60k pilot stipend (service credits) to support the Q4 POC, with an optional one-month extension if the team hits the milestone set below. To keep things tidy for finance and compliance, I sketched a short onboarding checklist and operational rules so your CTO and ops team can scope usage and reporting.

High-level offer:
- $60,000 in Redwood credits, valid for 90 days from activation
- One-month extension available if the POC passes the integration milestone by day 60
- Milestone: end-to-end demo using your 3 core flows (ingest -> embed -> generation) with <1s median token latency on dedicated test route

Action items I need from you by next Tue (Oct 5):
1) Confirm the primary POC owner (name + email)
2) Sign the mutual action agreement (MAA) attached
3) Provide a short list of expected peak seq lengths and daily volume estimates for the first 30 days

Attached: MAA_v1.docx (redlined), MVP-POC-plan.pdf (sample runbook).

If you want, we can lock in the credits now and set the activation date to when you flip the switch. If you'd prefer staged disbursement (30/30/40), we can do that too — just say which you prefer.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwoodai.com | +1 415-555-0147]

From: Samira Noor <samira@olivelabs.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Maya Rogers <maya.rogers@olivecorp.com>
Date: 2027-09-30T10:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Portfolio stipend: eligibility checklist & onboarding ops

Thanks Jordan — this is great and aligned with what we discussed. A couple quick notes before we sign: 

1) Can you confirm whether the credits can be used across both hosted and private (VPC) endpoints? We expect to run initial testing on hosted and a short private pilot for compliance.
2) Our legal team has a small wording ask on the MAA about data residency for logs (we prefer EU residency for logs if possible).
3) If we need the one-month extension we might not hit the exact token latency target on day 60; would Redwood consider an outcomes-based check (e.g., demo + perf trend showing steady improvement) rather than a hard cutoff?

Primary POC owner is Maya Rogers (maya.rogers@olivecorp.com) — she'll coordinate. I attached a short traffic snapshot and sequence distribution (see MVP-POC-plan.pdf).

Best,
Samira
Head of Integrations, Olive Labs

Quick internal: I read Samira's note. Two points from finance/compliance: 
- Credits are allowed across hosted and Redwood Private as long as the activation request specifies the environment split; Private usage will require a short order entry and an annex for data residency.
- For the one-month extension, we can be flexible with an outcomes-based check but need a sign-off gate: demo + perf trend + a short engineering acceptance note from their POC lead. That will be enough for finance to clear an extension.

Ben, please block a 30-minute rollout sync with Olive's Maya next week and include a stub for Annex A (data residency).

Samira —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming answers inline: 
1) Environment split: credits can be applied to both Hosted + Private. For Private, we will require the Annex A sign-off before activation; I asked Dev to draft the annex language for EU log residency.
2) MAA: we'll accept the legal wording ask; please send Samira's redline and we'll incorporate.
3) Extension: agreed — outcomes-based gate is acceptable (demo + perf trend + Maya sign-off). We'll capture that in the milestone language.

Ben will send an invite for a technical kickoff (include Maya + POC engineer). Once the MAA is signed we can issue the activation token and schedule the 90-day clock. If Olive prefers staged disbursement, call it out in the signed MAA.

Jordan
